_real_slabs_columns_meta: Added 2026-07-09: real_columns/real_slabs extracted directly from the live Rhino session (PershingInterventionMidterm.3dm) via execute_rhinocommon_csharp_code, bypassing the OBJ export pipeline (STRUC__Columns/STRUC__Slabs are Brep objects there and export with 0 faces -- see plan doc). real_slabs are per real planar plate (a west/east compound Brep yields 3 plates: two flat landings + one ramp), NOT per raw Rhino object -- kind is floor_slab (tilt_deg<0.5) or ramp_slab (tilt_deg>0.5, real ~1.7deg ramps found between levels). Coordinates: x/z site-local horizontal matching existing column_positions convention; z_top_ft/thickness_ft vertical, 0=grade, negative=below grade, matching terracing_engine.py voxel z_ft convention. Additive only -- existing column_positions/column_height_ft untouched.
